providerNative.name: validation_resources_propose
providerNative.description: Transactionally propose target-bound managed-validation resources and receive stable IDs plus a refreshed context hash.

providerNative.name: validation_reuse_resolve
providerNative.description: Pending service: resolve scenario realization reuse as exact_match, compatible_reuse, version_required, no_match, or ambiguous.

providerNative.name: validation_review_loop
providerNative.description: Wait for validation review to resolve through validations_approved, validation_changes_requested, or cancellation.

providerNative.name: validation_review_reconcile
providerNative.description: Recovery-only reconciliation for a review_ready validation after a crash. Normal validation decisions return the refreshed review binding atomically.

providerNative.name: validation_review_submit
providerNative.description: Explicit user/Appraise decision relay: submit the revision-level validation review after all required decisions are current.
